release_trains.name: foundation-preview
release_trains.label: engineering preview, not MVP
release_trains.entry_gate: S25 is merged through protected main and the S26 upstream, license and reproducibility inputs are accepted
release_trains.exit_gate: packaged three-platform shell opens the real workbench, projects a supervised Core and explains every outbound context fragment
non_claims: not a complete CodingAgent desktop product
no claim of governed code execution
no replacement for the existing Web supervisor

release_trains.name: governed-coding-alpha
release_trains.label: first desktop CodingAgent MVP
release_trains.entry_gate: RT-0 evidence is accepted and the real Core transport, identity and context boundaries pass adversarial review
release_trains.exit_gate: a real repository Goal runs through exact approval, isolated changes, tests, Hunk review, rollback and independent Evidence after Renderer restart
non_claims: no long-term knowledge or self-evolution claim

release_trains.name: collaborative-continuity-beta
release_trains.label: local-first beta
release_trains.entry_gate: RT-1 CodingAgent MVP is accepted without weakening Core authority, review or rollback
release_trains.exit_gate: isolated Agent teams, external continuity, governed knowledge, Armor, evolution and immune recovery pass combined failure and rollback scenarios

release_trains.name: enterprise-production-candidate
release_trains.label: production candidate
release_trains.entry_gate: RT-2 beta evidence, rollback and incident findings are accepted for the candidate scope
release_trains.exit_gate: signed artifacts on the supported platform matrix satisfy enterprise isolation, SLO, security, accessibility, recovery and fixed design-partner acceptance on one reviewed SHA
non_claims: no global rollout before production review
no server-readable private knowledge without separate consent
no remote or computer authority beyond the executing device Realm
